final: WITH account_orders AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) as order_count FROM `order` GROUP BY account_id), avg_orders AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) as avg_count FROM account_orders), above_average_accounts AS (SELECT account_id, order_count FROM account_orders WHERE order_count > (SELECT avg_count FROM avg_orders)), avg_above_average AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) as avg_above FROM above_average_accounts) SELECT account_id, order_count, order_count - (SELECT avg_count FROM avg_orders) as above_avg, order_count - (SELECT avg_above FROM avg_above_average) as above_above_avg FROM above_average_accounts ORDER BY above_above_avg DESC LIMIT 10
